Oblivion leaf static lighting: one normal and one packed color per billboard leaf; the later four-corner SpeedTree path is not present.
[RT4.1 parity v146 2026-10-07] Native processes one normal and packed color per leaf. Reference LightingEngine.cpp222-325 processes all four corners; SetColor defaults applyDimming=true in reference versus native false at7942CA. Reference shadow stage uses dominant light from the final corner. This path is NOT implemented by v146 dynamic normal smoothing; remains required for full parity.
[RT4.1 parity v147 2026-10-08] Lighting layout verified: leaf method+38, material+3C (13 floats), adjustment+70, style+74. Enabled lights B42A18 (8 bytes), attributes B2B7D0 (8x16 floats). New portable evaluator matches original reference lighting/SetColor/shadow excerpts in1234 checks, including clamp BEFORE dimming and final-corner dominant light shared by all shadow colors. Prepared-color cache is not an operational RGB renderer. Static mesh input rejected until its un-hung basis is captured.

OBLIVION AUTHORITY 2026-08-27: Static leaf color processing runs only when leafLightingMethod==1 (static) and staticLightingStyle!=0. Style bit0/value1 (USE_LIGHT_SOURCES) computes material/light RGB and SetColor(false); style bit1/value2 (SIMULATE_SHADOWS) runs AdjustStaticLighting, which SetColor(true) and reapplies colorScaleByte. Value3 would execute both in order.
